description: Shared reader policy: total-size gates are replaced by scalable access. Null values retire a gate; finite values describe active pages, previews and resource budgets.

editable_bytes.description: In-memory editor working budget; larger/long-line documents use editable pages and streaming atomic saves, without a file-size rejection.
editable_bytes.description_zh: 内存编辑器工作预算；更大或长行文档使用可编辑分页及流式原子保存，不拒绝整个文件。

editable_newlines.description: In-memory editor working budget; larger/long-line documents use editable pages and streaming atomic saves, without a file-size rejection.
editable_newlines.description_zh: 内存编辑器工作预算；更大或长行文档使用可编辑分页及流式原子保存，不拒绝整个文件。

line_bytes.description: In-memory editor working budget; larger/long-line documents use editable pages and streaming atomic saves, without a file-size rejection.
line_bytes.description_zh: 内存编辑器工作预算；更大或长行文档使用可编辑分页及流式原子保存，不拒绝整个文件。

page_bytes.description: Bytes per normal text page; following pages preserve the rest of the file.
page_bytes.description_zh: 普通文本每页读取字节数，后续页面保留其余完整内容。

full_bytes.description: Expanded-page working budget, not a full-file gate; previous/next controls keep the rest accessible. Editable and streamed sources also retain their own working budgets.
full_bytes.description_zh: 展开页的工作预算，不是完整文件门槛；上一页／下一页仍可访问其余内容，可编辑及流式来源还受各自工作预算管理。

full_newlines.description: Expanded-page working budget, not a full-file gate; previous/next controls keep the rest accessible. Editable and streamed sources also retain their own working budgets.
full_newlines.description_zh: 展开页的工作预算，不是完整文件门槛；上一页／下一页仍可访问其余内容，可编辑及流式来源还受各自工作预算管理。

layout_run_bytes.description: Maximum text run per virtual read-only row; long logical lines wrap into further rows without losing source bytes.
layout_run_bytes.description_zh: 只读虚拟行单次排版的文本预算；超长逻辑行拆成后续显示行，源字节不丢失。

preview_bytes.description: Bytes per hex page; previous/next controls expose the complete file.
preview_bytes.description_zh: 十六进制每页读取字节数，上一页／下一页可访问完整文件。

input_bytes.description: File-backed native image loading has no application input-byte or total-pixel gate; File bytes preserves complete source access.
input_bytes.description_zh: 基于文件的原生图片读取不设输入字节或像素总量门槛，“文件字节”保留完整源文件访问。

pixels.description: File-backed native image loading has no application input-byte or total-pixel gate; File bytes preserves complete source access.
pixels.description_zh: 基于文件的原生图片读取不设输入字节或像素总量门槛，“文件字节”保留完整源文件访问。

decoded_bytes.description: Active native/QOI preview raster working memory. QOI samples pixels while streaming instead of rejecting wide source scanlines; actual-size mode may use a scaled raster and complete original file bytes remain accessible.
decoded_bytes.description_zh: 原生／QOI 当前预览图片的工作内存。QOI 流式采样像素，不拒绝较宽的源扫描行；原尺寸模式可能使用缩放图片，完整原始文件字节仍可访问。

preview_edge.description: Initial ImageIO thumbnail resolution. Actual-size mode may increase the raster within image.decoded_bytes; it never rejects a file based on original dimensions.
preview_edge.description_zh: 初始 ImageIO 缩略图分辨率。原尺寸模式可在 image.decoded_bytes 内提高图片分辨率，不按原图尺寸拒绝文件。

preview_edge.description: Displayed animation texture edge, independent of source size and frame count.
preview_edge.description_zh: 动画显示纹理边长，与源文件大小和总帧数无关。

canvas_bytes.description: Compositing working memory; oversized source canvases are sampled while decoding rows instead of rejecting the animation.
canvas_bytes.description_zh: 合成工作内存预算；较大的源画布按行解码并采样，不拒绝整个动画。

batch_bytes.description: Per-batch animation prefetch budget; consumed frames are released and later frames remain available.
batch_bytes.description_zh: 每批动画预取预算；已消费帧会释放，后续帧仍可继续读取。

batch_frames.description: Per-batch animation prefetch budget; consumed frames are released and later frames remain available.
batch_frames.description_zh: 每批动画预取预算；已消费帧会释放，后续帧仍可继续读取。

decode_buffer_bytes.description: ImageIO loads the requested TIFF page on demand, with no application page-count or aggregate-preview total gate.
decode_buffer_bytes.description_zh: ImageIO 按需读取所请求的 TIFF 页，不设应用层页数或累计预览总量门槛。

pages.description: ImageIO loads the requested TIFF page on demand, with no application page-count or aggregate-preview total gate.

decoded_bytes.description: Inline thumbnail resolution/decoded/output working budget; the original remains available through its standalone reader or source URL.

bytes.description_zh: 结构化 XML 投影的工作缓冲预算，较大内容完整流式写入分页源码报告。

header_bytes.description_zh: 头部字符串 token 的工作缓冲预算；字段扫描覆盖完整流式头部，分页报告保留完整头部及支持类型的全部数值。

values.description: Supported numeric values stream to a disk-backed paged report; no prefix-only value count.
values.description_zh: 支持类型的数值流式写入磁盘分页报告，不再只保留前缀数量。

input_bytes.description: Static mesh projection working budget; larger projections open complete source/hex pages rather than rejecting or silently cutting the file.
input_bytes.description_zh: 静态网格投影工作预算；较大投影改为完整源码／十六进制分页，不拒绝或静默截掉文件。

vertices.description: Static mesh projection working budget; larger projections open complete source/hex pages rather than rejecting or silently cutting the file.
vertices.description_zh: 静态网格投影工作预算；较大投影改为完整源码／十六进制分页，不拒绝或静默截掉文件。

glyph_edge.description: Bitmap-font projection working budget; beyond it, complete BDF source pages remain available instead of a silently shortened glyph list.
glyph_edge.description_zh: 位图字体投影工作预算；超出后仍提供完整 BDF 源码分页，不静默缩短字形列表。

glyphs.description: Bitmap-font projection working budget; beyond it, complete BDF source pages remain available instead of a silently shortened glyph list.
glyphs.description_zh: 位图字体投影工作预算；超出后仍提供完整 BDF 源码分页，不静默缩短字形列表。

input_bytes.description: No file/name/count/report total gate. Read metadata through the io.cache_bytes working cache and spool reports; cache exhaustion opens complete file-byte pages. CString scans do not use the library prefix cutoff.
input_bytes.description_zh: 不设文件、名称、条目数或报告总量门槛。元数据读取使用 io.cache_bytes 工作缓存并落盘生成报告；缓存预算耗尽时打开完整文件字节分页。CString 不采用库内的前缀截取。

hex_bytes.description_zh: 元数据报告中的十六进制摘要，完整文件字节仍可通过原始字节分页访问。

header_bytes.description_zh: 元数据记录及 dtype 计数流式落盘；过大的单条记录改为完整头部分页，不读取张量权重。不设置头部、名称、形状、条目数量或报告总量门槛。

metadata_key_chars.description_zh: 元数据记录及 dtype 计数流式落盘；过大的单条记录改为完整头部分页，不读取张量权重。不设置头部、名称、形状、条目数量或报告总量门槛。

metadata_value_chars.description_zh: 元数据记录及 dtype 计数流式落盘；过大的单条记录改为完整头部分页，不读取张量权重。不设置头部、名称、形状、条目数量或报告总量门槛。

snapshot_bytes.description: Copy the snapshot in fixed-size blocks, without an application database total-size gate.
snapshot_bytes.description_zh: 按固定大小缓冲块复制快照，不设置应用数据库总大小门槛。

page_rows.description: Rows buffered per table/schema page, independent of total table size; a persistent pager provides row counts, page jumps and first/last navigation.
page_rows.description_zh: 表格／结构每页缓冲行数，与表总行数无关；常驻分页栏提供行数统计、页码跳转及首页／末页导航。

tables.description: List all tables and views without an application catalog-size cap.
tables.description_zh: 列出全部表和视图，不设置应用目录条目上限。

columns.description: All SQLite columns are accessible; horizontal virtualization bounds the working set.
columns.description_zh: 所有 SQLite 列均可访问；通过横向虚拟化限制工作集。

value_bytes.description: Use native SQLite format constraints; full values and definitions are read in text.page_bytes windows with previous/next navigation.
value_bytes.description_zh: 沿用原生 SQLite 格式约束；完整值及定义按 text.page_bytes 的窗口读取，并提供上一页／下一页。

text_bytes.description: Visible cell summary only; double-click opens a complete paged value, with binary values shown as hex.
text_bytes.description_zh: 仅控制单元格摘要；双击打开完整值分页，二进制值以十六进制显示。

schema_text_bytes.description: Use native SQLite format constraints; full values and definitions are read in text.page_bytes windows with previous/next navigation.
schema_text_bytes.description_zh: 沿用原生 SQLite 格式约束；完整值及定义按 text.page_bytes 的窗口读取，并提供上一页／下一页。

blob_bytes.description: Visible cell summary only; double-click opens a complete paged value, with binary values shown as hex.
blob_bytes.description_zh: 仅控制单元格摘要；双击打开完整值分页，二进制值以十六进制显示。

query_seconds.description: Initial cancellable query time allowance; Retry with more time explicitly extends it.
query_seconds.description_zh: 初始可取消查询时间预算，“延长时间重试”可明确增加预算。

busy_milliseconds.description: Native SQLite lock-wait allowance; a busy database can be retried and is not rejected by file size.
busy_milliseconds.description_zh: 原生 SQLite 锁等待时间；数据库忙碌时可重试，与文件大小无关。

cache_kib.description: SQLite page-cache working memory; larger databases read further pages from disk.
cache_kib.description_zh: SQLite 页缓存工作内存，较大的数据库继续从磁盘读取页面。

column_window.description: Columns fetched per horizontal viewport window, without a total column limit.
column_window.description_zh: 横向视口每次读取的列数，不限制总列数。

scan_bytes.description: Scan the current text for image references; large documents use source pages instead of a total reference-scan cutoff.
scan_bytes.description_zh: 扫描当前文本中的图片引用；大文档使用源码分页，不以引用扫描总量截掉后半部分。

input_bytes.description: HTTP downloads stream to a temporary file and prepare bounded thumbnails; source input size is not an application rejection gate.
input_bytes.description_zh: HTTP 下载流式写入临时文件，再生成有界缩略图，不以源输入总大小拒绝文件。

timeout_seconds.description: Idle/no-progress timeout; active downloads have no fixed total elapsed-time ceiling.
timeout_seconds.description_zh: 空闲／无进度超时，持续有进度的下载不设固定总耗时上限。

first_attempt_seconds.description: Connection establishment allowance, including the first GitHub raw URL attempt before API fallback.
first_attempt_seconds.description_zh: 连接建立时间预算，包括 GitHub 原始 URL 首次尝试后转用 API 的连接等待。

svg_embedded_bytes.description: Per-embedded-image working memory in SVG preparation; original SVG content remains available through Source or file-byte access.
svg_embedded_bytes.description_zh: SVG 准备过程中单个内嵌图片的工作内存，原始 SVG 内容仍可通过源码或文件字节访问。

redirects.description: Redirect-chain budget prevents request loops; it does not constrain image-file size.
redirects.description_zh: 重定向链预算用于避免请求循环，不限制图片文件总大小。

connect_seconds.description: Connection establishment allowance, including the first GitHub raw URL attempt before API fallback.
connect_seconds.description_zh: 连接建立时间预算，包括 GitHub 原始 URL 首次尝试后转用 API 的连接等待。

minimum_bytes_per_second.description: Minimum progress for the idle timeout, not a bandwidth ceiling.
minimum_bytes_per_second.description_zh: 空闲超时使用的最低进度判定，不是带宽上限。

blocks.description: Maximum diagrams per background render batch. Visible blocks queue automatically; this does not limit total document formulas or require manual paging.
blocks.description_zh: 后台每批图表渲染工作预算；可见图块自动排队，不限制文档公式总数，也无需手动翻页。

source_bytes.description: Per-diagram structured-render working budget; failures preserve the complete block source. Other blocks remain available on demand.
source_bytes.description_zh: 单个图表的结构化渲染工作预算；失败时保留完整图块源码，其余图块仍可按需访问。

svg_bytes.description: Per-diagram structured-render working budget; failures preserve the complete block source. Other blocks remain available on demand.
svg_bytes.description_zh: 单个图表的结构化渲染工作预算；失败时保留完整图块源码，其余图块仍可按需访问。

aggregate_encoded_bytes.description: Encoded/decoded working budget for the viewport diagram cache and active render batch. Older resources are evicted and can be requested again; total document blocks remain unrestricted.
aggregate_encoded_bytes.description_zh: 可视区域图表缓存与当前渲染批次的编码／解码工作预算；旧资源可淘汰后再次按需生成，不限制文档图块总数。

aggregate_decoded_bytes.description: Encoded/decoded working budget for the viewport diagram cache and active render batch. Older resources are evicted and can be requested again; total document blocks remain unrestricted.
aggregate_decoded_bytes.description_zh: 可视区域图表缓存与当前渲染批次的编码／解码工作预算；旧资源可淘汰后再次按需生成，不限制文档图块总数。

preview_edge.description: Active raster resolution/scale budget. Page raster dimensions also adapt to aggregate working memory, independently of document length.
preview_edge.description_zh: 当前图片的分辨率／缩放预算；每页图片尺寸还按聚合工作内存调整，与文档总长度无关。

startup_seconds.description: Cancellable renderer startup/per-block time allowance; an unfinished block shows its complete source instead of rejecting the Markdown document.
startup_seconds.description_zh: 可取消的渲染器启动／单块时间预算；未完成图块显示完整源码，不拒绝整个 Markdown 文档。

block_seconds.description: Cancellable renderer startup/per-block time allowance; an unfinished block shows its complete source instead of rejecting the Markdown document.
block_seconds.description_zh: 可取消的渲染器启动／单块时间预算；未完成图块显示完整源码，不拒绝整个 Markdown 文档。

ipc_bytes.description: One page/request or one block IPC working buffer; document batches are paged and oversized render results preserve the complete source block.
ipc_bytes.description_zh: 一页请求或单图块的 IPC 工作缓冲预算；文档按页处理，过大的渲染结果保留完整图块源码。

slot_bytes.description: One page/request or one block IPC working buffer; document batches are paged and oversized render results preserve the complete source block.
slot_bytes.description_zh: 一页请求或单图块的 IPC 工作缓冲预算；文档按页处理，过大的渲染结果保留完整图块源码。

max_upscale.description: Active raster resolution/scale budget. Page raster dimensions also adapt to aggregate working memory, independently of document length.
max_upscale.description_zh: 当前图片的分辨率／缩放预算；每页图片尺寸还按聚合工作内存调整，与文档总长度无关。

request_bytes.description: One page/request or one block IPC working buffer; document batches are paged and oversized render results preserve the complete source block.
request_bytes.description_zh: 一页请求或单图块的 IPC 工作缓冲预算；文档按页处理，过大的渲染结果保留完整图块源码。

message_bytes.description: One page/request or one block IPC working buffer; document batches are paged and oversized render results preserve the complete source block.
message_bytes.description_zh: 一页请求或单图块的 IPC 工作缓冲预算；文档按页处理，过大的渲染结果保留完整图块源码。

mermaid_edges.description: Per-diagram structured-render working budget; failures preserve the complete block source. Other blocks remain available on demand.
mermaid_edges.description_zh: 单个图表的结构化渲染工作预算；失败时保留完整图块源码，其余图块仍可按需访问。

math_macros.description: Math interpreter expansion budget to bound recursive work; the complete formula source remains available when rendering cannot finish.
math_macros.description_zh: 公式解释器的展开工作预算，控制递归工作量；无法完成渲染时仍保留完整公式源码。

chapter_bytes.description: Structured chapter working budget. When exceeded, retain chapter navigation and provide complete UTF-8 source pages, with streamed transcoding for supported legacy encodings. No chapter is silently cut off.
chapter_bytes.description_zh: 章节结构化排版工作预算。超出时保留章节导航并提供完整源码分页，支持的旧编码通过流式转码读取，不静默截掉章节。

xml_nodes.description: Structured chapter working budget. When exceeded, retain chapter navigation and provide complete UTF-8 source pages, with streamed transcoding for supported legacy encodings. No chapter is silently cut off.
xml_nodes.description_zh: 章节结构化排版工作预算。超出时保留章节导航并提供完整源码分页，支持的旧编码通过流式转码读取，不静默截掉章节。

resource_bytes.description: Requested archive images stream to a private file and use native thumbnail decoding; no source-resource byte or pixel-edge gate. Only the active chapter/page previews are retained.
resource_bytes.description_zh: 所请求的包内图片流式写入私有临时文件，再由原生接口生成缩略图；不按资源字节总量或原图边长拒绝打开，仅保留当前章节／页面预览。

preview_edge.description: Thumbnail resolution for the requested illustration/comic page; this does not reject the original image.
preview_edge.description_zh: 当前插图／漫画页的缩略图分辨率，不以此拒绝原始图片。

input_bytes.description: No application book/archive/chapter/catalog/metadata total gate. Structured parsing keeps a working budget; oversized metadata exposes every archive member as complete source or byte pages.
input_bytes.description_zh: 取消书籍、压缩包条目、章节、目录和元数据总量门槛。结构化解析保留工作预算；复杂元数据改为列出全部包内成员，提供完整源码或字节分页。

text_bytes.description: Structured chapter working budget. When exceeded, retain chapter navigation and provide complete UTF-8 source pages, with streamed transcoding for supported legacy encodings. No chapter is silently cut off.
text_bytes.description_zh: 章节结构化排版工作预算。超出时保留章节导航并提供完整源码分页，支持的旧编码通过流式转码读取，不静默截掉章节。

archive_entries.description: No application book/archive/chapter/catalog/metadata total gate. Structured parsing keeps a working budget; oversized metadata exposes every archive member as complete source or byte pages.
archive_entries.description_zh: 取消书籍、压缩包条目、章节、目录和元数据总量门槛。结构化解析保留工作预算；复杂元数据改为列出全部包内成员，提供完整源码或字节分页。

chapters.description: No application book/archive/chapter/catalog/metadata total gate. Structured parsing keeps a working budget; oversized metadata exposes every archive member as complete source or byte pages.
chapters.description_zh: 取消书籍、压缩包条目、章节、目录和元数据总量门槛。结构化解析保留工作预算；复杂元数据改为列出全部包内成员，提供完整源码或字节分页。

metadata_bytes.description_zh: 取消书籍、压缩包条目、章节、目录和元数据总量门槛。结构化解析保留工作预算；复杂元数据改为列出全部包内成员，提供完整源码或字节分页。

toc_entries.description: No application book/archive/chapter/catalog/metadata total gate. Structured parsing keeps a working budget; oversized metadata exposes every archive member as complete source or byte pages.
toc_entries.description_zh: 取消书籍、压缩包条目、章节、目录和元数据总量门槛。结构化解析保留工作预算；复杂元数据改为列出全部包内成员，提供完整源码或字节分页。

toc_depth.description: Visual TOC indentation only; retain all nested entries and their actual hierarchy depth instead of cutting the catalog.
toc_depth.description_zh: 仅控制目录的视觉缩进，保留全部嵌套条目及实际层级，不截掉目录。

fb2_depth.description: Structured chapter working budget. When exceeded, retain chapter navigation and provide complete UTF-8 source pages, with streamed transcoding for supported legacy encodings. No chapter is silently cut off.
fb2_depth.description_zh: 章节结构化排版工作预算。超出时保留章节导航并提供完整源码分页，支持的旧编码通过流式转码读取，不静默截掉章节。

html_depth.description: Structured chapter working budget. When exceeded, retain chapter navigation and provide complete UTF-8 source pages, with streamed transcoding for supported legacy encodings. No chapter is silently cut off.
html_depth.description_zh: 章节结构化排版工作预算。超出时保留章节导航并提供完整源码分页，支持的旧编码通过流式转码读取，不静默截掉章节。

chapter_decoded_bytes.description: Structured chapter working budget. When exceeded, retain chapter navigation and provide complete UTF-8 source pages, with streamed transcoding for supported legacy encodings. No chapter is silently cut off.
chapter_decoded_bytes.description_zh: 章节结构化排版工作预算。超出时保留章节导航并提供完整源码分页，支持的旧编码通过流式转码读取，不静默截掉章节。

chapter_images.description: Structured chapter working budget. When exceeded, retain chapter navigation and provide complete UTF-8 source pages, with streamed transcoding for supported legacy encodings. No chapter is silently cut off.
chapter_images.description_zh: 章节结构化排版工作预算。超出时保留章节导航并提供完整源码分页，支持的旧编码通过流式转码读取，不静默截掉章节。

image_decoded_bytes.description: Requested archive images stream to a private file and use native thumbnail decoding; no source-resource byte or pixel-edge gate. Only the active chapter/page previews are retained.
image_decoded_bytes.description_zh: 所请求的包内图片流式写入私有临时文件，再由原生接口生成缩略图；不按资源字节总量或原图边长拒绝打开，仅保留当前章节／页面预览。

image_edge.description: Requested archive images stream to a private file and use native thumbnail decoding; no source-resource byte or pixel-edge gate. Only the active chapter/page previews are retained.
image_edge.description_zh: 所请求的包内图片流式写入私有临时文件，再由原生接口生成缩略图；不按资源字节总量或原图边长拒绝打开，仅保留当前章节／页面预览。

bookmarks.description: Persist all bookmarks, labels and reading-state entries; no application bookmark-count or input-size gate.
bookmarks.description_zh: 保存全部书签、标签和阅读状态记录，不设置应用书签总数或输入总大小门槛。

label_bytes.description: Persist all bookmarks, labels and reading-state entries; no application bookmark-count or input-size gate.
label_bytes.description_zh: 保存全部书签、标签和阅读状态记录，不设置应用书签总数或输入总大小门槛。

input_bytes.description: Persist all bookmarks, labels and reading-state entries; no application bookmark-count or input-size gate.
input_bytes.description_zh: 保存全部书签、标签和阅读状态记录，不设置应用书签总数或输入总大小门槛。

label_chars.description: Derived bookmark/header/catalog label excerpt; chapter targets and full-metadata/text dialogs retain the complete content.
label_chars.description_zh: 派生书签、书籍标题和目录标签摘要；章节目标及完整元数据／文本弹窗保留全部内容。

points.description: Coordinates per table page; previous/next navigation covers all GPX/KML points and Source preserves the complete XML.
points.description_zh: 每页坐标数量；上一页／下一页可访问全部 GPX/KML 点，源码保留完整 XML。

search_results.description: Visible page/batch size; later search results or saved workspaces remain accessible through continuation controls.
search_results.description_zh: 可见页／批次大小，后续搜索结果或已保存工作空间可通过继续浏览入口访问。

search_entries.description: Search traverses all eligible entries with cancellable result pages; there is no entry-scan total cutoff.
search_entries.description_zh: 搜索遍历全部符合条件的条目并提供可取消的结果分页，不设置扫描条目总数截断。

recent_workspaces.description: Visible page/batch size; later search results or saved workspaces remain accessible through continuation controls.
recent_workspaces.description_zh: 可见页／批次大小，后续搜索结果或已保存工作空间可通过继续浏览入口访问。

session_bytes.description: Stream session JSON and preserve all actual windows, roots and tabs while validating identities and active indexes.
session_bytes.description_zh: 流式读写会话 JSON，校验身份及活动索引，保留全部实际窗口、根目录和标签页。

workspaces.description: Stream session JSON and preserve all actual windows, roots and tabs while validating identities and active indexes.
workspaces.description_zh: 流式读写会话 JSON，校验身份及活动索引，保留全部实际窗口、根目录和标签页。

roots_per_workspace.description: Stream session JSON and preserve all actual windows, roots and tabs while validating identities and active indexes.
roots_per_workspace.description_zh: 流式读写会话 JSON，校验身份及活动索引，保留全部实际窗口、根目录和标签页。

tabs_per_workspace.description: Stream session JSON and preserve all actual windows, roots and tabs while validating identities and active indexes.
tabs_per_workspace.description_zh: 流式读写会话 JSON，校验身份及活动索引，保留全部实际窗口、根目录和标签页。

input_bytes.description: Native metadata artwork is thumbnailed without an application byte gate. Open full artwork exposes its complete original snapshot.
input_bytes.description_zh: 原生元数据封面不设置应用层字节门槛；“打开完整封面”提供完整原始快照。

preview_edge.description: Active cover thumbnail resolution; Open full artwork retains full-resolution source access.
preview_edge.description_zh: 当前封面缩略图分辨率；“打开完整封面”保留完整原图访问入口。

buffer_bytes.description: Fixed working buffer for cancellable streaming reads, copies and report generation, independent of total source size.
buffer_bytes.description_zh: 可取消流式读取、复制及报告生成的固定工作缓冲，与源文件总大小无关。

cache_bytes.description: Working cache/projection allowance for decoded text, executable metadata and vector/font projection buffers. Old text ranges regenerate; oversized representations retain complete source/byte pages.
cache_bytes.description_zh: 解码文本、可执行文件元数据及网格／字体投影缓冲的工作缓存预算。旧文本范围可重新生成；较大的表示仍保留完整源码／字节分页。

record_bytes.description: One active XML/structured metadata record or value, independent of total file size; oversized records retain complete Source/header pages or native preview access.
record_bytes.description_zh: 单条活动 XML／结构化元数据记录或值的预算，与文件总大小无关；过大的记录仍可通过完整源码／头部分页或原生预览访问。

event_bytes.description: One active XML markup/text record in the sanitizer, not a document total gate; native File bytes retains the complete source when preparation exceeds this budget.
event_bytes.description_zh: 清理器中单条活动 XML 标记／文本记录的工作预算，不是文档总量门槛；超出准备预算时，原生阅读器“文件字节”仍保留完整源文件。

zoom_min_percent.description: Minimum Word reading-view presentation zoom; does not constrain source content.
zoom_min_percent.description_zh: Word 阅读视图最小显示缩放，不约束源文件内容。

zoom_max_percent.description: Maximum Word reading-view presentation zoom; does not constrain source content.
zoom_max_percent.description_zh: Word 阅读视图最大显示缩放，不约束源文件内容。

zoom_step_percent.description: Zoom-in/out button increment in Word reading view; reset restores 100 percent.
zoom_step_percent.description_zh: Word 阅读视图缩放按钮的百分比步长；重置恢复 100%。

xml_bytes.description: Maximum source or expanded diagram XML per preview; larger documents fall back to source pages.
xml_bytes.description_zh: 预览源文件或解压后单页 XML 的预算；超过预算时回退到源码分页。

nesting.description: Bound parent traversal and detect cyclic groups.
nesting.description_zh: 限制父级遍历深度并检测循环分组。

preview_bytes.description: Aggregate encoded PNG page memory; larger documents fall back to source pages.
preview_bytes.description_zh: 所有 PNG 预览页的总编码内存预算；超过时回退到源码分页。

xml_bytes.description: OPML XML preview budget; fall back to source pages when exceeded.
xml_bytes.description_zh: OPML XML 预览预算；超过时回退到源码分页。

nodes.description_zh: 预览驻留大纲节点预算。

pending_paths.description: Maximum distinct pending filesystem paths. Overflow triggers a full source check instead of dropping changes; document access is unlimited.
pending_paths.description_zh: 待处理文件变化路径的去重预算。超出后执行完整来源检查，不丢弃变化，也不限制文档访问。

document_concurrency.description: Process-wide concurrent document loading and refresh jobs. Additional jobs wait asynchronously and can be canceled; file access is unlimited.
document_concurrency.description_zh: 进程内文档加载与刷新的并发任务预算。其余任务异步排队并可取消，不限制文件访问。

projection_concurrency.description: Process-wide concurrent data projection and page preparation jobs. Additional jobs wait asynchronously and can be canceled; file access is unlimited.
projection_concurrency.description_zh: 进程内数据投影与分页准备的并发任务预算。其余任务异步排队并可取消，不限制文件访问。

decode_concurrency.description: Process-wide concurrent image and animation decoding jobs. Additional jobs wait asynchronously and can be canceled; file access is unlimited.
decode_concurrency.description_zh: 进程内图片与动画解码的并发任务预算。其余任务异步排队并可取消，不限制文件访问。

native_concurrency.description: Process-wide concurrent native document preparation jobs. Additional jobs wait asynchronously and can be canceled; file access is unlimited.
native_concurrency.description_zh: 进程内原生文档准备的并发任务预算。其余任务异步排队并可取消，不限制文件访问。

diagram_concurrency.description: Process-wide diagram batch preparation concurrency. Waiting batches yield workers and retain their cancellation flag.
diagram_concurrency.description_zh: 进程内图表批次准备的并发预算。排队批次不占工作线程，并保留取消标志。

cache_bytes.description: Process-wide budget for tracked reclaimable reader caches; evict background then least recently used unpinned values. Live state and active work are accounted separately and never discarded as cache. Framework allocations are outside this ledger.
cache_bytes.description_zh: 进程级可回收阅读器缓存预算；先回收后台缓存，再回收最近最少使用且无使用者持有的值。存活状态与活动工作另行记账，不作为缓存丢弃；框架内部内存不在此账本内。
